entries.title: Mark 11:1
segments: And when they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent out two of His disciples.

entries.title: Mark 11:2
segments: And He said to them, Go into the village over across from you. And as soon as you have entered into it, you will find a colt tied, on which no one of men has ever sat. Untie it and bring [it].

entries.title: Mark 11:3
segments: And if anyone says to you, Why do you do this? Say that the Lord has need of him, and immediately he will send him here.

entries.title: Mark 11:4
segments: And they went, and they found the colt tied by the door outside, in a place where two ways met. And they untied him.

entries.title: Mark 11:5
segments: And certain of those who stood there said to them, What are you doing, untying the colt?

entries.title: Mark 11:6
segments: And they said to them even as Jesus had commanded. And they let them go.

entries.title: Mark 11:7
segments: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and they threw their garments on it. And He sat on it.

entries.title: Mark 11:8
segments: And many spread their garments in the way, and others cut down branches off the trees and scattered [them] in the way.

entries.title: Mark 11:9
segments: And those going before, and those following, cried out, saying, Hosanna! Blessed [is] He who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord!

entries.title: Mark 11:10
segments: Blessed [is] the kingdom of our father David, who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

entries.title: Mark 11:11
segments: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem and into the temple. And when He had looked around on all things, the hour already being late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

entries.title: Mark 11:12
segments: And on the next day, they going out of Bethany, He was hungry.

entries.title: Mark 11:13
segments: And seeing a fig-tree with leaves afar off, He went [to it], if perhaps He might find anything on it. And when He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not [the] season of figs.

entries.title: Mark 11:14
segments: And Jesus answered and said to it, No one shall eat fruit of you forever. And His disciples heard.

entries.title: Mark 11:15
segments: And they came to Jerusalem. And entering into the temple, Jesus began to cast out those who bought and sold in the temple. And He overthrew the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold doves.

entries.title: Mark 11:16
segments: And [He] would not allow any to carry a vessel through the temple.

entries.title: Mark 11:17
segments: And [He] taught, saying to them, Is it not written, "My house shall be called the house of prayer for all nations?" But you have made it a den of thieves.

entries.title: Mark 11:18
segments: And the scribes and the chief priests heard. And they sought how they might destroy Him. For they feared Him, because all the people were astonished at His doctrine.

entries.title: Mark 11:19
segments: And when evening came, He went out of the city.

entries.title: Mark 11:20
segments: And passing on early, they saw the fig-tree dried up from [the] roots.

entries.title: Mark 11:21
segments: And Peter, remembering, said to Him, Rabbi, behold, the fig tree which You cursed has withered away.

entries.title: Mark 11:22
segments: And answering Jesus said to them, Have faith of God.

entries.title: Mark 11:23
segments: For truly I say to you that whoever shall say to this mountain, Be moved and be cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that what he said shall occur, he shall have whatever he said.

entries.title: Mark 11:24
segments: Therefore I say to you, All things, whatever you ask, praying, believe that you shall receive [them], and it will be to you.

entries.title: Mark 11:25
segments: And when you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive [it] so that also your Father in Heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

entries.title: Mark 11:26
segments: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in Heaven forgive your trespasses.

entries.title: Mark 11:27
segments: And they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders came to Him

entries.title: Mark 11:28
segments: and said to Him, By what authority do you do these things? And who gave you this authority to do these things?

entries.title: Mark 11:29
segments: And Jesus answered and said to them, I will also ask of you one thing, and answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.title: Mark 11:30
segments: The baptism of John, was [it] from Heaven, or from men? Answer Me.

entries.title: Mark 11:31
segments: And they reasoned within themselves, saying, If we shall say, From Heaven, he will say, Why then did you not believe him?

entries.title: Mark 11:32
segments: But if we shall say, From men, they feared the people, for all held John to be a prophet indeed.

entries.title: Mark 11:33
segments: And they answered and said to Jesus, We cannot tell. And answering Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
